newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid $64, passed - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid $64, passed - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle bids at $64.00 early Wednesday were passed by owners pricing cattle at $65.00, feedlot sources said.
Limited sales were reported on Tuesday at $64.00, but the majority of cattle feeders passed the bids, anticipating higher prices in the face of sharply higher beef prices.

Fed cattle prices also were seen higher on talk that several packers were short of cattle and needed to fill inventories for Thursday's slaughter, several sources said. Higher prices in Nebraska Tuesday amid active trading also fueled outlooks for higher Panhandle area and Kansas cattle.
